Description: Sample identifier extracted from the VCF header; unique identifier for each analyzed sample
Name of the gene at the 5' (upstream) end of the fusion partner
Name of the gene at the 3' (downstream) end of the fusion partner
Fusion junction coordinates in format Chr1:RNA_BK1::Chr2:RNA_BK2 (e.g., "1:12345::5:67890")
Whether a reciprocal fusion was detected (Y/N); reciprocal fusions have both Gene_A::Gene_B and Gene_B::Gene_A
Confidence classification level (1-7); lower numbers indicate higher confidence
Fusion category: inter_chromosomal (different chromosomes), intra_chromosomal (same chromosome), or read_through (adjacent genes)
Count of encompassing RNA-seq reads (read pairs where each mate maps to a different fusion partner gene)
Count of spanning RNA-seq reads (individual reads that cross the actual fusion junction)
Count of encompassing WGS reads from tumor sample (read pairs supporting the genomic breakpoint)
Count of spanning WGS reads from tumor sample (reads crossing the genomic breakpoint)
List of fusion transcript variant isoforms detected for this gene pair
RNA-seq determined breakpoint coordinate for the 5' fusion partner
RNA-seq determined breakpoint coordinate for the 3' fusion partner
Detailed information about splice junctions involved in the fusion (moved to last column in output)
Computed ranking score based on percentile ranks of all four read count columns (Span_RNA, Split_RNA, Span_DNA_T, Split_DNA_T); used for sorting within tier
